title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks shared by every Advisorydeck v1 schema.

slug.description: Stable public key of a product: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.

category.description: Catalog category. databases (databases, caches, queues and search engines), proxies (web servers, reverse proxies and load balancers), os (operating systems and kernels), paas (self-hosted platforms), containers (container engines such as dockerd and containerd, runc, orchestration and container tooling), runtimes (language runtimes that app containers run on), auth (identity, single sign-on and secrets), monitoring (metrics, logs, dashboards and uptime checks), storage (files, photos, media, backups, object storage and image registries), devtools (git hosting, CI and remote development environments), apps (applications deployed from templates: CMS, chat, automation, AI front ends).

upstream.title: Upstream
upstream.description: Set only when the upstream project no longer ships fixes (archived on its forge, retired by its vendor). Consumers show it next to every advisory and summary for the product, so a user knows to plan a move instead of waiting for a fix.

status.description: archived: the upstream repository or project is archived or retired and no further releases are expected.

since.description: When upstream archived or retired the project.

note.description: One or two plain sentences for the user: what happened and where to look (a maintained fork, the vendor's notice).

versionScheme.description: How versions of a product compare. semver: semantic versions, prereleases included. pg: PostgreSQL style major.minor (the major is the branch). calver: dotted calendar versions. dpkg: Debian package versions. kernel: Linux kernel versions. opaque: equality only.

version.description: A version or branch string as the vendor writes it, without a leading v.

severityLevel.description: Qualitative severity. unknown means no score was found; it is shown, never dropped.

advisoryId.description: An advisory identifier such as CVE-2026-120154, GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx or USN-1234-1.

githubHandle.description: A GitHub user name, without the @.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date and time in UTC.

etag.description: sha256 of the exact bytes of the file it describes.
